settings.about.autoCheck: Check for updates when Druse opens
settings.about.autoCheckHint: Asks GitHub which is the latest published version. It is an HTTPS request and carries no SQL or credentials; GitHub receives the IP address and the request headers. Without it, Druse doesn''t connect on its own, and you can check by hand whenever you like.
